reviewer: Codex direct review of generated answers and admitted citation text
criteria: Answer the actual question with the required cause, action or distinction.
Retain material qualifiers from document evidence and prior conversation.

interpretation: This is a strict direct agent acceptance review of simulated sample questions, not calibrated judge scores, production use or a percentage of project completion. Extra fixture claims not requested by the question are not mandatory. A group with at least one supporting citation may pass with a warning for irrelevant additional citations.
